result:
I’d make the consequences of our choices impossible to ignore.

Not in a punitive way—more like: if you harmed someone, neglected someone, or benefited from someone else’s suffering, you would understand that reality clearly, emotionally, and without the ability to look away.

I think so much cruelty survives because distance, abstraction, and self-deception make it easy to ignore. If that ignorance disappeared, a lot of the world would have to change.
